decision: kept for scoped production admission: exact outputs and complete reports are preserved, with broad query-time improvement and explicitly accepted resource tradeoffs

independent_extrema_matrix.coverage: Two policies, four signed/extreme scales, cold/warm input intervals, all six three-point permutations and nine independent coordinate/tie patterns. Additional empty/singleton/duplicate/near-coincident rational controls.

resource_review.timing_interpretation: Three production medians are 1.3-2.0% slower, with overlapping five-sample ranges and variable construction controls. The earlier focused large-batch/CPU-conditioned comparisons improve these questioned cases. Retention does not assert a uniform improvement or cold-start benefit; all unfavorable samples remain recorded.
resource_review.memory_interpretation: Three tiny-quadratic rows retain 12288/8960/8960 additional bytes per 256 results (peak increases 11904/8960/8960). Their query medians improve 49.6%/27.3%/10.8%, and requested allocation traffic decreases in each. These repeatable memory tradeoffs are accepted under performance before memory. No allocation-call or allocated-byte row increases.
resource_review.binary_interpretation: Timing/allocation executables shrink by 2896/5152 bytes; text shrinks by 976/2896 bytes and rodata by 160 bytes in both.

next_step: Apply and stage only the two audited production source files, verify their staged hashes against the tested source archive, then rerun the original full-board gate on the broader native prototype. Its prior failed gate and remaining admission requirements remain open.
limitations: Production timing follows fixed 100 ms integer-only CPU conditioning before geometry construction, and does not claim cold-start latency improvement. The original unconditioned and focused trials remain in diagnostics-38/39. No persistent cache, scalar proof-budget change, full-application speedup, broad native admission or property-completion claim. Twenty-eight existing curve ignores and the complete workspace/pre-push matrix remain outside this scoped admission.
